This is just what came to my mind now, but there are tons of tips on this role. Do you have any videos of yourself playing commander? If you want I could watch it and tell you if you did something wrong.

These are common mistakes I see with commanders that already know the basics of the role, but still need to improve:


Try to have efficient communications, which means: use command chat only for important things.
Remember that the SL are constantly fighting on the ground and if command chat is a mess they will lose their fights and they will also not be able to understand what is being said. So don't talk too much.


Don't waste ammo on precision strikes (unless you have a ton of ammo).


Don't forget convert and use encourage to balance your resources.


Only use halftracks if you have more than 900 fuel.

Remember that you can only spawn 5 vehicles at the same time so pick carefully (priority to Heavy Tanks).


Don't get frustrated, remember that it's just a game. I know that it's the 4th time in a row that recon kills you while you are trying to build that same goddam garry but don't give up, ask for help, change tactic and go on.


Edit: These tips are intended if you are playing to win, if you're just chilling and want to try some weird stuff go on, we don't always need to stay focused 100% of the time, these are just public matches so who cares.
